programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Derived from the University of Hyderabad Prospectus 2026-27 first-semester fee table, MBA row: other fee 6,660 + tuition 46,720 (payable every semester) + students' union 580 + medical insurance 2,010 + student welfare/aid 260 (payable each July-December semester) + refundable deposits 5,485 (at admission) = Rs 61,715 for semester 1. Two-year estimate excl. refundable deposit = 4 x 53,380 + 2 x 2,850 = Rs 2,19,220 at 2026-27 rates (later-semester fees may be revised; medical insurance is at actuals). Hostel/mess extra. MBA Business Analytics is a separate, costlier programme (Rs 1,52,395 in semester 1).
programs.intakeNote: MBA 2026-28 admission notification: intake 75 (GE 30, SC 11, ST 6, OBC 20, EWS 8) plus PH 4 and DP 4; foreign nationals up to 15% supernumerary. 2027-29 notification not yet issued as of 2026-11-12 (2026-28 notification was issued 9 Jan 2026).
programs.placementNote: No official MBA placement statistics found; prospectus only describes placement facilitation through a faculty coordinator and the University's Placement Guidance and Advisory Bureau.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT / MAT / CMAT score
selectionProcess.detail: 2026-28 cycle: CAT 2025, MAT 2025 or CMAT 2026; eligibility first-class (60%) bachelor's degree. IIMs have no role in selection.

selectionProcess.name: Group Discussion and Interview at University campus
selectionProcess.detail: Held Feb/Mar for shortlisted candidates (at own cost); admissions finalised end of March; classes from July. Weights not published.

keyDates.notes: 2027-29 notification not yet published as of 2026-11-12. For reference, the 2026-28 cycle: notification 9 Jan 2026; last date 31 Jan 2026, extended to 28 Feb 2026 (web page shows a further extension to 20 Mar 2026); GD/PI Feb/Mar 2026; classes July 2026. Application fee: General Rs 600, EWS 550, OBC 400, SC/ST/PwD 275.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100 (University of Hyderabad is ranked in other NIRF categories)
